item.title: 6 citizens sue Trump, saying media ban deprives them of news as audience stakeholders
item.description: A new lawsuit against President Donald Trump's media ban stakes a claim for the public itself. The lawsuit was filed on behalf of six ordinary citizens.

item.title: Egypt's parliament authorizes military support for Saudi Arabia to defend against Houthi attacks
item.description: Egypt’s parliament has voted to authorize President Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi to provide Saudi Arabia with military support in defending the kingdom against attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels.

item.title: A cartoonist takes Japan’s new imperial succession law to court over male-only heirs
item.description: A popular Japanese cartoonist has sued the government over a revised imperial succession law. The law allows royals to adopt male relatives from former branch families to father future heirs.

item.title: Eric Bauza, modern voice of Looney Tunes characters, dies at 46
item.description: The modern voice of Looney Tunes has died. Eric Bauza was the award-winning performer whose 400 voice acting credits include Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and many more characters.
